About To Allahabad High Court RO ARO CA Recruitment 2026

The Allahabad High Court has released the notification for the recruitment of Review Officer (RO), Assistant Review Officer (ARO), and Computer Assistant (CA) posts for the year 2026. Eligible candidates holding a Bachelor’s Degree (Graduation) can apply online from 01 June 2026 to 21 June 2026. A total of 543 vacancies have been announced under this recruitment drive. Interested candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully before applying online.
